- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score

response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Frequent vehicle safety incidents, hazardous waste classification errors, lack of legal compliance register, no formal environmental aspect identification","recommendations":"Implement a robust safety management system to reduce vehicle incidents, train staff on proper hazardous waste classification, establish a legal compliance register, conduct formal environmental aspect identification","standards":"ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001"}
